citations.narrative:
The black bear enclosure has a wooden platform that the bears can go under and climb on top of. The wooden platform
has a board that has been broken from the top and hanging at a downwards angle. The board has sharp and jagged
edges that could potentially cause injury.
The bobcat enclosure has a gap underneath the metal siding (to the left of the outside opening of its shelter) with jagged
edges. The jagged edges could cause injury.
The housing facilities shall be structurally sound and maintained in good repair to protect the animals from injury. The
wooden platform in the bear enclosure and the gap underneath the metal siding in the bobcat enclosure needs to be
repaired/replaced so it doesn't cause injury to the animals within those enclosures.
Correct by 8/20/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
End of report.
